edits.new_content:
version: 2

models:
  - name: metricflow_time_spine
    description: One row per calendar day, 2025-2027. MetricFlow's time spine.
    time_spine:
      standard_granularity_column: date_day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - date_day
          population:
            rule: Every calendar day from 2025-01-01 to 2027-12-30.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Spine range
              chosen: 2025-2027
              evidence: default
              detail: covers the control year, the study year and the recovery tail
    columns:
      - name: date_day
        description: Calendar day.
        granularity: day
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: key
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
